feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 1059 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 20 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: Barbershop Chair Profit Calculator — Haircut Price, Booth Rent vs Commission
entry.summary: Free barbershop calculator: enter haircut, beard and combo prices, chair minutes, supplies, no-show rate, rent and commission, and see profit per cut and per chair hour, the price for your target margin, break-even cuts per week and whether to rent the chair or employ a barber. Runs in your browser.
